The Leopards, led by 26th-year head coach [[Fran O'Hanlon]], play their home games at the [[Kirby Sports Center]] in [[Easton, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Patriot League]]. With the creation of mini-divisions to cut down on travel due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they play in the Central Division.{{Cite news|url=https://patriotleague.org/news/2020/11/9/mens-basketball-patriot-league-plan-on-2021-basketball-season-starting-in-january.aspx|title=Patriot League Plan on 2021 Basketball Season Starting in January|work=Patriot League|date=November 9, 2020|accessdate=January 17, 2021|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Lafayette Leopards men's basketball team|Leopards]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 19–12, 10–8 in Patriot League play to finish in a tie for fourth place. They defeated [[2019–20 Army Black Knights men's basketball team|Army]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]],{{Cite news|url=https://goleopards.com/news/2020/3/5/mens-basketball-balanced-attack-propels-mens-hoops-to-plt-semifinals.aspx|title=Balanced Attack Propels Men's Hoops to PLT Semifinals|work=Lafayette
